name: How long do mobile home repairs typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long do mobile home repairs typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of mobile home repairs varies greatly depending on the complexity and extent of the damage. Minor fixes might be completed in a single day, while more extensive projects such as roof replacement, subfloor overhaul, or major structural work could take several days to a few weeks. We will provide an estimated timeline after assessing your specific repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair duration depends on complexity; minor fixes might be a day, while extensive projects can take several days to weeks.
